statement: Linux v6.12 hid-wiimote matches Bluetooth-bus Nintendo 0x057e products 0x0306 and 0x0330; it does not declare a separate Wii U Pro product ID in this match table.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Bluetooth HID identity accepted by kernel table; actual retail Wii U Pro product ID is not measured.
